lead.claim: For chronic stroke hand rehab, sensory ES and Alt-EMG are equally effective.
lead.context: *Why this matters*: This RCT compared two types of electrical stimulation, both combined with conventional therapy, for improving upper-limb motor function.

supporting.claim: Adding PBMT to exercise offers no extra benefit for chronic non-specific low back pain.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: This RCT tested if adding light therapy to exercise improved pain or disability in people with long-term lower back issues.

supporting.claim: Supervised telerehab with Pilates and self-massage aids fibromyalgia recovery.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: This RCT evaluated a 6-month remote program combining exercise and self-care for fibromyalgia impact and symptoms.

supporting.claim: Exercise improves walking economy in healthy adults; effects are smaller in stroke patients.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: This systematic review synthesised evidence on how exercise training affects the energy used for walking across different health conditions.

supporting.claim: In frail older adults, swallowing problems link to poor physical function and falls.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: This study explored the relationship between difficulty swallowing and physical performance and fall risk in older individuals.
